$comment: Pinned inputs and outputs of the patched obs-nvenc.dll (tools/obs-patch/build-obs-nvenc.mjs; ADR docs/adr/2026-11-05-obs-nvenc-destroy-order.md). Only obs-nvenc.dll/.pdb are replaced in the runtime; the originals are copied to <runtime>/../<backupDir>/obs-plugins/64bit/ first. 'patched' is written by --record. Licence: obs-nvenc is GPL-2.0-or-later (OBS Studio); source offer in docs/third-party-notices.md.

nvCodecHeaders.why: The shipped 32.1.2 plugin logs 'NVENC version: 12.2 (compiled)'. n12.2.72.0 is the only nv-codec-headers 12.2 tag (checked 2026-11-06), and obs-deps deps.ffmpeg/70-nv-codec.ps1 pinned exactly this commit whenever it used 12.2 (e.g. obs-deps aa3edad9). Which obs-deps release built the shipped 32.1.2 is UNVERIFIED; the header version match is what matters for the ABI with the driver.
